list: The official 55 trophies as published on PlayStation and mirrored by PSNProfiles and Exophase (reported by Push Square, 18 Nov 2026): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden until earned, none online.
note: Grand Theft Auto VI launched 19 Nov 2026. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry. Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; the method notes paraphrase the cited guides and never copy their text. Where no guide has pinned a trigger down yet, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours; there is nothing extra to do for it. Because every trophy on the list is single-player and offline, nothing here can expire when a server shuts down. Follow the roadmap in order and this one arrives last, usually right after A Long Road.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: One of the first missions of Chapter 1, so just play the story from the start and it unlocks on its own. It is hidden on PlayStation until you earn it, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy that unlocks automatically at the chapter's end; there is no way to miss it, and no mission replay is needed for it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy it unlocks on its own when the chapter ends, so keep playing the story and it will come.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 3 is also where several side systems open up, so it is a good moment to start sampling activities for Master of None.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy, unmissable. Bank vault robberies open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, so this chapter is also the start of Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story, in Chapter 5. This is one of only two gold trophies on the list and the only hidden gold. It unlocks automatically when the credits roll, and from there the game continues in free roam for everything that is left.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. Story trophies like this one unlock automatically and cannot be missed, so just follow the mission markers.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Automatic and unmissable, like every named-mission trophy on the list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission at the airport. Automatic and unmissable. The airport itself matters for one more trophy later: Catch Me If You Can also happens at VCIA.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. Automatic and unmissable; it is the last of the named-mission trophies before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but anything you do during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy and notes the thresholds are lenient, closer to 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts. Nothing on the checklist is missable; every requirement can still be finished in free roam after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, per PowerPyx. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road; every stunt past the trophy still pays toward it.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. One attempt at every activity type is enough; you do not need to win, finish or master any of them. Work down the activities list in the pause menu and tick each type off as you sample it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Gold is required in every single one, so expect to replay the tougher ranges until the medal lands. PowerPyx rates the golds as not too difficult, and the ranges are also part of the 100% checklist, so this overlaps directly with A Long Road.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations: one win per spot is enough for the trophy. All 42 races count toward 100%, so keep racing after the trophy pops if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not add to the count, so spread your wins across the map instead of farming one easy race.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Per GTA Zone, Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon, so follow the text rather than searching the map at random. Win the challenge he sets and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find any arcade cabinet, pick a game and play it through to the end; the shortest game you can find is the fastest route to this one.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, the last job in his strand of side missions. His strand stays open after the story, so there is no rush, but note that Andy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do his jobs for this trophy alone.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, the last job in his strand of side missions. Like the other side-character finales it stays available after the story, so finish it during the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and the strand stays open after the story, so work through all five and the finale unlocks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every strand counts: per GTA Zone, Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. Check who the strand giver is before investing time, and note that PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which strands qualify.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, the last job in his strand of side missions. It stays available after the story, so finish it during cleanup.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, the last job in his strand of side missions. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do it for this trophy alone; it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, split between Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy PowerPyx flags as potentially missable: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway to be safe. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note that 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is separate from A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only. The exact animal is not yet confirmed by the guide writers, so check the current guides when you reach Bret's strand rather than hunting at random.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. You only need three sets, so chase the sets whose cards you find first instead of trying to finish all of them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Any mix counts: Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags, per GTA Zone. Photograph things as you travel and the count builds up on its own; save a dedicated sweep for whatever types you are still short on.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so you can skip the hardest ten and still finish both trophies; pick the challenges that suit your play style first and leave the awkward ones for last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the law up to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear; do not let your partner get caught or killed on the way out.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The chain is the tricky part: keep the heat on through all three robberies, because if the wanted level drops between shops the count resets and you start over. Plan a route of three close shops and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them. Scan every new vehicle you see; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so scanning is a habit worth building from the first hour rather than a grind left for the end.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter first, then trigger it with an assault rifle in a busy fight, per GTA Zone's tip; a crowded shootout gives you the five targets before the meter runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Per GTA Zone: steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about 1 km away. Expect airport security on the way in, so go in with a plan and a fast route to the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it; the Rhinos of the description are the tanks. Once you are in the driver's seat, use the cannon on the soldiers who come for you.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Per GTA Zone, Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for the back door, so use it to get in quietly instead of smashing the front. Move slowly, watch the sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of the 8 in the game. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway, per GTA Zone. All 8 vaults count toward 100%, so keep robbing past the five this trophy needs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Per GTA Zone, a bank vault job also counts if you get away, so this one may pop on its own while you work on Maximum Withdrawal; otherwise watch for armored trucks on the road and hit one when the route is clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map across its 52 areas. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map, per GTA Zone, so do a flyover once the map is open and mop up any foggy corners on the ground.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang: one per gang, 9 gangs in total. All 39 operations count toward 100%, so keep robbing past the one-per-gang minimum instead of stopping at nine.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide writers: the description points to a specific bar spot on Ocean Beach, so check the current guides before hunting it rather than drinking at every bar in town.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Unconfirmed by the guide writers, but the description points to driving out through the showroom window, per GTA Zone; find a showroom, get a car inside, and go out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Per GTA Zone: rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. The trophy is tied to the robbery at that alley, not to a game of bowling.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Per GTA Zone: max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia, and working out together trains both at once, so pair your gym sessions instead of grinding each character separately.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, so this one builds up over a full playthrough of making choices in the world. GTA Zone warns: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, because it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide writers; the name suggests succeeding on a retry after a first failure, so keep an eye out for moments where a second attempt pays off, and check the current guides for the cracked method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide writers; the description points to a strange random event somewhere in Leonida, so explore odd corners of the map and check the current guides once players have pinned the event down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide writers; the name points to knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, so try a drive-by swing from a slow-moving car or bike.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, so every laundered bill adds up, and per GTA Zone Yasmani pays the most, so use him whenever you can to reach the total faster.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total. Ordinary shopping counts, so it builds up over a full playthrough; if you are close at the end, buy the big-ticket items you have been putting off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 for sale, about $160,000 in total, per GTA Zone. The 4 story garages do not count, so only the ones you buy yourself matter; save up and work through the for-sale list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for the registrations, so keep a few slots open and register vehicles as you find them.
